blocks.text: BULUAN, Maguindanao del Sur — Seventeen years after the Maguindanao massacre claimed the lives of 58 people, including 32 journalists and media workers, the families of the victims are still waiting for full justice. Ricardo Cachuela, from Koronadal City, whose brother was among the journalists killed in the Nov. 23, 2009 massacre, said the conviction of the principal accused in 2019 was only the first step toward justice for the victims. “Only the conviction has been achieved. The damages have not been paid,” Cachuela said in an interview. READ: Maguindanao massacre: PTFOMS vows to pursue arrest of remaining accused Cachuela appealed […]...
